title: Multiacc PokeIdle
summary: User and admin guide for running multiple PokeIdle accounts in Docker containers via a local web panel, plus central deployment, release publishing and E2E runs.
scope: docker-compose user install (mpw-web, control-plane, worker, updater)
local web panel on 127.0.0.1:3000 and ALLOWED_HOSTS
game account registration, proxy test and pokeweb:tokens needs-login flow
stopping and removing managed worker containers (label mpw.managed=true, volume mpw_mpw-data)
central-api on Kubernetes cluster tcgreaper, namespace pokeidle (k8s/base Kustomize, Traefik, cert-manager, NetworkPolicy, pg_dump backup CronJob)
central-api on VPS via docker-compose.central.yml with reverse proxy (Caddy/nginx)
admin user management (create, deactivate, reset password, role change, ci-release admin)
release workflow release.yml and ci.yml publishing ghcr.io/ayresigo/mpw-* images to stable/beta channels
Playwright E2E smoke with fake-game (e2e/docker-compose.e2e.yml, project mpw-e2e)
